source: synthetic Maharashtra GePNIC IT services tender (evals/golden/in/gepnic_mh_it_services)

requirements.text: पात्रता मानदंड: The bidder shall have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 2,50,00,000 in the last three financial years.
The bidder shall pay an EMD of Rs. 5,00,000 online through the Maharashtra tenders portal.
The bidder shall have at least 3 years of experience operating a tier III or higher data centre.
MSEs and recognised startups are exempted from the EMD on submission of the relevant certificate.
The bidder shall hold a valid ISO 27001 certificate covering data centre operations.
10.1 The service provider shall operate the state data centre on a 24x7 basis with a minimum of 18 deployed engineers.
10.2 The service provider shall maintain 99.5 percent uptime for hosted services measured monthly.
10.3 The service provider must conduct a vulnerability assessment every quarter and close critical findings within 15 days.
10.4 The service provider shall provide a monthly service level report within five working days of month end.
10.5 The service provider should propose automation that reduces manual operational effort year on year.
The technical cover shall not exceed 80 pages excluding annexures.
Bids shall be uploaded on the Maharashtra tenders portal before 05:00 PM IST on 08-12-2026.
Both covers shall be digitally signed with a Class 3 DSC issued to the authorised signatory.
The bidder shall upload the ISO 27001 certificate and three client reference letters.
Evaluation will follow a quality and cost based selection with 70 percent weight on technical score.
The technical score will consider relevant experience, the proposed team and the transition plan.
